purpose: Bind Satoshi lore, environment, wardrobe, props, framing, and visible dialogue into one production object.

environment_selection.principle: The environment should reveal topic, character history, or the joke before the evidence section begins.
prefer: setting that supports the fictional lore

wardrobe_selection.principle: Wardrobe adapts to the world while preserving Satoshi identity.
approved_archetypes: suit only when the story context specifically calls for it

example_scenes.environment: abandoned arcade with one Tetris cabinet still glowing
example_scenes.wardrobe: rumpled dark overshirt over charcoal T-shirt
example_scenes.lighting: flickering cabinet light with dim practical overheads
example_scenes.camera_framing: medium shot, cabinet visible over shoulder
example_scenes.persona_hook: I spent six months consulting for an arcade chain that went bankrupt before the invoice cleared. Tetris was the only machine anyone still played.
example_scenes.pivot_line: Which, apparently, was the medically interesting part.
example_scenes.why_this_setting_fits: The arcade visually communicates the subject and reinforces Satoshi's failed-operator history.
example_scenes.continuity_notes: Adds failed arcade-chain consulting to fictional lore.

example_scenes.environment: industrial produce-testing kitchen with cut fruit and instrumented workbench
example_scenes.wardrobe: dark work shirt with sleeves rolled
example_scenes.lighting: bright task lighting with darker background
example_scenes.persona_hook: I actually worked with the Fruit Ninja people. My job was kiwi fracture mechanics. Pineapple was substantially harder.
example_scenes.pivot_line: Apparently we should have been measuring reading scores.
example_scenes.why_this_setting_fits: The setting literalizes the joke and makes the topic legible before exposition.

example_scenes.environment: dim abandoned diagnostics startup lab with phlebotomy chair and boxed analyzers
example_scenes.lighting: cold fluorescent lab light with one warmer practical
example_scenes.camera_framing: medium shot seated near phlebotomy chair
example_scenes.persona_hook: At Theranos, my main job was being bled. I am talking liters over the course of a month. By week three, I had opinions about assay validation.
example_scenes.pivot_line: Which is why I pay attention when the sample gets smaller and the claims get bigger.
example_scenes.why_this_setting_fits: The environment supports the fictional first-person premise while transitioning naturally into diagnostic evidence.
